title: Arbitrary-and-capricious review
question: How closely do courts review agency reasoning?

steps.note: Hard look at the record; the agency must show it considered the statute’s factors.
Rescinding a rule gets the same review; the agency must connect facts to choice.
A policy change needs a reasoned explanation, not a heightened one.
The agency must consider reliance interests and alternatives within its stated grounds.
Failure to respond to significant comments can sink a rule, even at the stay stage.
